candidate.definition_en: Never ending or changing; occurring repeatedly so as to seem continuous.
candidate.explanation_ar: حاجة مستمرة على طول ومش بتخلص ولا بتقف، أو بتتكرر كتير جداً لدرجة إنها كأنها دايمة.

senses.definition_en: Continuing forever or indefinitely without interruption.
senses.explanation_ar: مستمر دائماً دون انقطاع أو تغيير أبدي.
examples: The mountains are covered in perpetual snow.
They lived in perpetual fear of being discovered.

senses.definition_en: Occurring repeatedly and frequently, often to an annoying degree.
senses.explanation_ar: متكرر باستمرار لدرجة أنه يبدو بلا نهاية.
examples: She was tired of their perpetual arguments.
The mountains are covered in perpetual snow.
They lived in perpetual fear of being discovered.
She was tired of their perpetual arguments.
candidate.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Pet' (حيوان أليف): الـ 'Pet' محتاج رعاية 'perpetual' (دايمة ومستمرة).
